headline: 今日零新片，蜘蛛侠新作领跑热搜
headlineEn: Zero Releases Today, Spider-Man Leads Trending
summary: 今日无新片上映，本周仅3部新片。热搜榜由《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》领跑，《逃出绝命街》《末日地堡》紧随；周榜则多部IP剧集与电影持续霸榜。
summaryEn: No new films hit theaters today; only three opened this week. Spider-Man: Brand New Day leads daily trends, followed by Escape from Death Street and Doomsday Bunker, while multiple IP series and films dominate the weekly chart.

industryHighlights.text: 今日0部新片上映，本周共有3部新片
industryHighlights.en: Zero releases today; three new films this week.

industryHighlights.text: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》成为今日及本周双榜第一
industryHighlights.en: Spider-Man: Brand New Day tops both daily and weekly trends.

industryHighlights.text: 《逃出绝命街》紧随其后，热度与冠军接近
industryHighlights.en: Escape from Death Street follows closely, nearly matching the leader.

industryHighlights.text: 《权力的游戏前传：龙族》等剧集进入周榜，IP衍生内容持续吸金
industryHighlights.en: House of the Dragon and other series hit weekly charts as IP-driven content stays strong.

industryHighlights.text: 本周新片数量较少，档期热度集中在头部作品
industryHighlights.en: With fewer new releases this week, attention is concentrated on top titles.
